preconditions.expression: isinstance(jumble, str) and isinstance(dictionary, list) and all(isinstance(word, str) for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: The input `jumble` must be a string, and `dictionary` must be a list of strings.
Every word in the dictionary must be a non-empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(word in dictionary for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every word in the returned list must exist in the input dictionary.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(word) == sorted(jumble) for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every word in the returned list must be an anagram of the input `jumble`.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for word in dictionary if sorted(word) == sorted(jumble))
postconditions.description: The returned list must contain exactly the words from the dictionary that are anagrams of `jumble`, preserving their original order.
